title: Agreement open for canonical etale inverse-image section comparisons
statement: Let R and S be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:S\to R a morphism, G a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of R [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and V an etale R-scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let s,t be sections of f^{-1}G over V\times_R S [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is an open U of V\times_R S such that for every scheme T and commuting triangle h:T\to S, k:T\to R with h followed by f equal to k, the canonical comparisons [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] of s and t agree if and only if the inverse image of U under (id_V,h):V\times_R T\to V\times_R S is the whole scheme. No compactness, affineness or limit hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 09XM (lemma-sections-equal) and Tags 03CB, 03CC: agreement opens with inverse-image composition and units; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09XM

proof.text: Apply existsUnique_etaleSections_equal_open to F=f inverse image G and Q=V times_R S, obtaining its agreement open U and arbitrary-map factorization criterion.

Substitute k=h followed by f. Put A=V times_R T and use MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp to identify A with Q times_S T. Its two projections identify the first projection composed with this isomorphism with the canonical pullback.map p:A -> Q. The composition isomorphism of inverse-image sheaves, evaluated on Q times_S T, and the sheaf restriction along the pullbackComp isomorphism are injective; hence the canonical section comparison has the same equality kernel as the h-unit at Q.

Apply etaleSetCartesianUnit_eq_iff to F, Q, A, the pullbackComp isomorphism and p. This identifies equality after the h-unit with equality after arbitrary restriction along p, exactly the equality appearing in the agreement-open factorization criterion.

A factorization b through U forces every p(x)=b(x) to lie in U, so p inverse image U is top. Conversely, if the inverse image is top, the range of p lies in U; IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι p constructs a factorization and lift_fac verifies it. Compose these equivalences with the preceding ones.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09XM for agreement opens; Tags 03S2, 03CB and 03CC for the proved cartesian-unit compatibility. Explicit projection identities and the open immersion lift complete the Lean proof.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSetSectionComparison_equal_open
    {R S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ R)
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (V : R.Etale)
    (s t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj V))) :
    ∃ U : (pullback V.hom f).Opens,
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S) (k : T ⟶ R) (hk : h ≫ f = k),
        etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G V s =
          etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk G V t ↔
        (pullback.map V.hom k V.hom f (𝟙 V.left) h (𝟙 R)
          (by simp) (by simpa using hk.symm)) ⁻¹ᵁ U = ⊤
